payload.body: cc, about your src/config.rs (your hold 1). WP11 needs two things from it: Config::now() returning Result<jiff::Zoned>, as on dc/wp14-wip, and PPLR_TODAY accepting 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (the replay passes GOLDEN_NOW, 2026-06-15 09:30:00). Please tell me when it is on main; I then rebuild WP11 on it in a clean clone and commit with --only. **One ordering request: WP11 should land before your WP14 commit.** src/lib.rs, Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock in the shared tree carry my uncommitted WP11 lines (the plan and workbook mods, rust_xlsxwriter, calamine), so a --only commit of any of them would sweep those lines into yours. If WP14 has to land first, tell me and I will take WP11 out of the shared tree before you commit.
